main.description: Fetch a single live HLS segment, or a track's init segment, from the in-memory live window. `seg` is `init` for the EXT-X-MAP init segment, otherwise the segment's media-sequence number; a cosmetic `.m4s` suffix is accepted (and ignored) so ffmpeg-based HLS players will fetch it. HTTP Range is honored. Segments are the verbatim signed canonical .m4s, so provenance travels with playback. With `captions`, `seg` is a subtitle segment's media-sequence number (the same numbering as the video's, with a cosmetic `.vtt` suffix) and the response is a text/vtt document.

streamer.description: The streamer: a DID or a Bluesky handle (resolved to its DID).

track.description: Track ID (stringified u32 matching the MUXL container). Required unless `captions` is set.

captions.description: Caption track id from place.stream.caption.listTracks, for a WebVTT subtitle segment instead of a media segment.

seg.description: `init` for the track's init segment, or the segment's media-sequence number. A trailing `.m4s` (`.vtt` with `captions`) is accepted and ignored.

sid.description: Opaque playback session identifier, propagated from the media playlist that referenced this segment. Logged for view-count correlation; not used for access control.

errors.name: StreamNotLive
errors.description: No live window for this streamer on this node.

errors.name: SegmentNotFound
errors.description: The requested segment has slid out of the window, or never existed.
